name: Print Loud
description: A hands-on screen-print workshop and late-night poster show for people who like their ink loud, their edges imperfect, and their sleeves rolled up.
ticketDisclaimer: Remaining ticket counts are committed static values, updated manually by the organizer. They are not live inventory and availability is confirmed only when booking.

ticketTiers.name: First Pull
ticketTiers.description: Workshop entry, blank tote, and first access to the ink tables.

ticketTiers.name: Full Bleed
ticketTiers.description: The full workshop with an extra tee and a guided colour-separation session.

ticketTiers.name: Night Pass
ticketTiers.description: Skip the workshop and join the poster exhibition, DJs, and print swap.

faq.question: Do I need screen-printing experience?
faq.answer: No. First-time printers are welcome, and every station has an experienced printmaker nearby.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Wear something you do not mind getting inky. Aprons and gloves are provided, but screen-print ink has a talent for travel.

faq.question: Can I bring my own garment?
faq.answer: Yes. Bring one light-coloured cotton item with a smooth print area. Textured, waterproof, and heavily stretchy fabrics may not print cleanly.

faq.question: Are tickets refundable?
faq.answer: Tickets can be transferred to another person. Refund requests received at least seven days before the event are handled by the organizer.

faq.question: Is the venue accessible?
faq.answer: The workshop floor and toilets are step-free. Email the organizer before booking if you need a seated workstation or other adjustments.
